purpose: Canonical, NON-SECRET inventory of the environment variables the Meta WhatsApp Cloud integration reads. Variable NAMES only. No value, sample value, token, secret or identifier appears here or ever may.
authority_note: This manifest documents the loaders in lib/communication/providers/metaCloudWhatsAppConfig.ts. It is a description, not a second configuration system: nothing reads this file at runtime, and adding a name here does not create a variable.
warnings: Values are never stored in the repository. They live only in the deployment environment.
Configuration readiness is NOT activation, and activation is NOT business authorisation.
A build must require no Meta credential. Provider selection is resolved lazily at runtime.
In production an absent or invalid WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_MODE fails closed and never falls back to mock.

webhook_get.description: Meta subscription verification. Echoes hub.challenge after a constant-time verify-token comparison.

webhook_post.description: Inbound/delivery webhook signature verification over the exact raw bytes.

callback_identity.description: Proves a callback belongs to our WABA and phone number before any database effect.

health.description: Read-only phone-number lookup used for provider health.

consent_ack_worker.description: Cron-triggered acknowledgement delivery worker. Transport-agnostic; gated by a shared secret, not by Meta credentials.

build.loader: none — a build must never require a Meta credential

variables.name: WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_MODE
variables.safe_default: mock outside production only; NO default in production
variables.activation_dependency: Selecting meta_cloud is not activation; the runtime policy still gates every operation.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Bearer token for Graph API calls. Sent only in the Authorization header.
variables.storage: deployment secret store; never in the repository
variables.activation_dependency: Presence enables the possibility of a send, never the permission.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_WABA_ID
variables.purpose: WhatsApp Business Account identifier used for outbound and callback identity.
variables.validation: META_CALLBACK_ID_GRAMMAR (digit/identifier grammar enforced by the loader)
variables.activation_dependency: Must match the provider account row before outbound can pass its gate.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
variables.purpose: Meta phone-number identifier used for outbound, health and callback identity.
variables.activation_dependency: Must match the provider account row before outbound can pass its gate.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_GRAPH_API_VERSION
variables.purpose: Graph API version segment in every request URL.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET
variables.purpose: HMAC key for verifying the webhook signature over exact raw bytes.
variables.activation_dependency: Absent app secret makes every signature verification fail closed.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Shared token Meta echoes during subscription verification.
variables.activation_dependency: Independent of outbound; verification can be configured before sending is possible.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_AUTH_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.purpose: Request timeout for the authentication lane, sized to fit inside the auth hook budget.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.purpose: Request timeout for the business lane.

variables.name: WHATSAPP_HEALTH_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.purpose: Request timeout for the health check. Falls back to the business timeout when unset.
variables.safe_default: 10000, or the business timeout when unset

variables.name: QF_CRON_SECRET
variables.purpose: Shared secret protecting the acknowledgement-worker cron trigger. Compared in constant time and never logged.
variables.storage: deployment secret store; also held by whatever schedules the cron
variables.activation_dependency: Knowing the secret permits triggering a bounded batch. It selects no recipient and authorises no send.

staging_configuration_packet.note: Operator checklist for QF-MVP-40.10. NOT executed by this phase. No seed statement is included and no value appears.

runtime_policy_starting_state.reason: Staging currently has NO runtime policy row at all, so the canary must create one. It starts fully closed and is opened one gate at a time.

provider_account_starting_state.phone_number_reference: supplied by the operator at configuration time
provider_account_starting_state.business_account_reference: supplied by the operator at configuration time
provider_account_starting_state.configuration_status: incomplete until every configuration check passes
provider_account_starting_state.webhook_status: unverified until the GET subscription check succeeds
provider_account_starting_state.health_status: unknown or unhealthy until a health check succeeds

canary_destination.destination_hash: hash only — a plaintext number must never be stored
canary_destination.expires_at: required, or explicitly reviewed and recorded if omitted

provider_mappings.rule: No mapping row may exist until the template is externally approved by Meta.
provider_mappings.fields: exact provider template name, language and category, matching the approved submission
provider_mappings.fingerprint: content fingerprint is recomputed and compared with exact equality at the network boundary
provider_mappings.note: Inactive until the canary step. Every catalogue entry remains DRAFT_NOT_SUBMITTED today.
